newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends slightly higher, tech stocks mixed.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends slightly higher, tech stocks mixed.

text.p: Nasdaq shares showed modest gains amid a mixed performance by key technology issues.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 3.92 points or 0.27 percent to 1442.07. Shares settled into a middle range after hitting a high of 1448.68 and a low of 1432.07. Gaining issues beat losers 2505 to 1849 on total volume of 638 million. The Russell 2000 index, a key barometer of small capitalization issues, added 3.85 points or 0.98 percent to 396.38.
"There was really no consensus or direction today. There continues to be a few stocks hit by earnings fears but the techs really didn't have any major momentum around them today," one trader said.
Intel Corp, Microsoft Corp and 3Com Corp posted moderate losses, while Dell Computer Corp and Cisco Systems Inc firmed.
Other traders said stronger-than-expected manufacturing and home sales data sparked fears of inflation ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting set for Tuesday and Wednesday.
Stratasys Inc lost 5-5/8 or more than 26 percent to 16-1/8 after the company said it expects second quarter revenues to fall short of analysts' expectations.
